discovery.area: SCOPE B3: industry and multistakeholder bodies (FMF, PAI, EU codes) and summit/G7 commitments (Seoul, Delhi, Hiroshima/OECD)
discovery.summary: No new cross-firm commitment or code since June 2026 was found. Updates to existing entries: the HAIP Reporting Framework v2.0 (28 May 2026) and publication of v2.0 reports from 31 companies (2 Oct 2026); the GPAI Code's Signatory Taskforce, chaired by the AI Office (page updated 3 Aug 2026), with the Code itself unchanged since Jul 2025; the FMF information-sharing agreement (Mar 2025, operating), absent from the map. FMF and PAI 2026 outputs are research and guidance, not mechanisms. Seoul signatories unchanged since Feb 2025; Delhi list dated 23 Feb 2026. The G7 Évian summit (15–17 Jun 2026) adopted no AI text; Macron said AI work would be finalised in ministerial formats.

discovery.area: B4 labs (Layer 6): Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI — new framework versions since Jun 2026, SB 53 / RAISE / EU Code compliance frameworks, governance-body changes
discovery.summary: No lab issued a new safety-framework version after June 2026 except xAI (FAIF effective 30 Jun 2026). But three entries described superseded versions: OpenAI's entry described the 2023 beta (v2 Apr 2025 is current); DeepMind's misdated v2/v3 (v3.1 Apr 2026 is current); Meta's missed v2's change from "stop" to "develop with mitigations". OpenAI designated GPT-6 Astra its first Critical (cyber) model on 1–3 Sep 2026 and paused some training for two weeks. Compliance documents: OpenAI's FGF (28 May 2026) is its TFAIA framework and EU Code summary; xAI's Dec 2025 edition claimed TFAIA compliance but the Jun 2026 edition is silent on it; no Google or Meta SB 53 document found. Anthropic RSP v3.4 remains current (page updated 14 Aug 2026 with the Aug 2026 Risk Report).

discovery.area: B3 multilateral bodies and processes (L1): AISR, AISI Network/NAAIMES, AI summit series, OECD (incl. HAIP), Council of Europe, UNESCO; UN bodies as proposed additions
discovery.summary: Since June 2026: the network issued its first best-practice guidance (Jul 2026). No new AISR publication after 3 Feb 2026. Geneva summit fixed for 21–22 Jun 2027 with Fabiola Gianotti as delegate; UAE co-chairs 2027 and hosts 2028. Delhi Declaration reached 92 endorsers. OECD AI Recommendation gained Cambodia and Croatia (May 2026). EU concluded the CoE Convention (Apr/May 2026), but it is not in force. UNESCO Global Forum (Riyadh, Sep 2026) produced no new instrument. UN Scientific Panel issued its Preliminary Report (1 Jul 2026) and a loss-of-control brief (21 Sep 2026); first Global Dialogue held Jul 2026. Drafted one addition (UN Panel & Dialogue).

discovery.summary: No amendment to SB 53 (BPC §22757.10ff) found. New since June 2026: SB 813 (Ch. 179) and AB 1405 (Ch. 178), signed 9 Sep 2026, create a GovOps framework for designating independent verification organizations (by 1 Jan 2028) and an AI auditor registry (by 1 Jan 2029); EO N-9-26 (18 Sep 2026) accelerates SB 813 to 1 May 2027 and orders recommendations by 16 Nov 2026 on embedding IVOs in large frontier developers, independent verification of SB 53 documents, a frontier-model "kill switch" and loss-of-control incidents. Other AI bills signed 30 Sep 2026 (SB 947 employment ADS, AB 2713 provenance, health-care AI) are not frontier-specific. No AG enforcement action under SB 53 and no CalCompute appropriation found.
